items.title: Why did the support6 CYP2D6 probe fail?
assumptions: The fixed 7.0626% hidden-prevalence estimate is used only to translate leaderboard bootstrap means into aggregate true-positive equivalents.

source.label: Official CYP classification leaderboards

metricDefinitions.label: CYP2D6 MCC
metricDefinitions.definition: CYP2D6 MCC is the official bootstrap-mean Matthews correlation coefficient on confidently scored hidden labels.

caveats: Official precision, recall and accuracy are bootstrap means and cannot be inverted into exact per-compound hidden labels.

evidenceFlow.title: Submission comparison
evidenceFlow.detail: The control and support6 rows use the same endpoint and each submitted vector contains 49 positive calls.

methods.code:
Estimated TP share = 0.0706257 × recall
Estimated TP-equivalent loss per 750 = 750 × (0.0270843 − 0.0135150) = 10.18

source.label: Recorded swap-neighborhood diagnosis

metricDefinitions.label: Morgan support
metricDefinitions.definition: Morgan support is the maximum radius-2, 2,048-bit Tanimoto similarity to any labeled training compound.

metricDefinitions.label: Label-aware neighborhood rate
metricDefinitions.definition: The top-k positive rate is the fraction of the k most Morgan-similar labeled training compounds carrying the positive D6 label.

caveats: Training-neighbor diagnostics are descriptive and do not identify which individual blind compounds are hidden positives.

evidenceFlow.title: Uncertainty check
evidenceFlow.detail: Two-sided 10,000-permutation tests compare the 27 control-only and 27 support6-only compounds; 10,000 within-cohort bootstrap resamples provide the reported intervals.

source.label: Recorded member-call dependence

metricDefinitions.label: Member call dependence
metricDefinitions.definition: Pairwise phi and Jaccard measure agreement among the six fixed-rate TabPFN 3.5-fast member call vectors.

filters: Members: three feature pools across random and scaffold splits

evidenceFlow.title: Effective vote count
evidenceFlow.detail: Under an exchangeable-correlation approximation, 6 / (1 + 5 × 0.8646) = 1.13 independent votes.

sourceRoles.label: member-call-dependence.csv
sourceRoles.role: Pairwise call overlap for the six support6 members.
